page_title: WOL 1-3 AUG | Wolfsburg v Augsburg 16/03/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Augsburg have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90+3' Sven Michel (Augsburg) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
90+1' A fine solo run by Sven Michel (Augsburg) takes him deep into the box, but it comes to nothing as his shot flies well wide of the right post.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
87' Niko Kovac prepares a substitution. Mattias Svanberg is replaced by Aster Vranckx (Wolfsburg).
86' The referee allows time for a substitution. Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) will be replaced by Rogerio.
86' The total number of attempts is 14:12.
83' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) comes off the pitch to be replaced by Sven Michel.
82' Dion Beljo joins the action as a substitute, replacing Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg).
82' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Timo Gerach had an easy-decision to make.

79' 1 - 3 Arne Engels slides a pass towards Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the bottom left corner. The score is now 1:3.
78' Substitution. Lovro Majer (Wolfsburg) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Ridle Baku walks off.
78' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Timo Gerach blows his whistle for a foul.
76' Jess Thorup has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Mads Pedersen (Augsburg) replacing Arne Maier.
76' Substitution. Ruben Vargas will be replaced by Arne Engels (Augsburg).
74' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate.
74' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted. The ball is behind the touchline and Wolfsburg will take a throw-in.
72' Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
71' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) watches the ball all the way and fires a first-time shot goalwards from inside the box, but the effort flies just over the bar.
70' Pep Biel (Augsburg) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
68' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
67' Niko Kovac decides to make a substitution. Tiago Tomas will be replaced by Amin Sarr (Wolfsburg).
65' That's the end of the game for Fredrik Jensen, who is replaced by Pep Biel (Augsburg).
64' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
64' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
61' 1 - 2 Goal! Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) fires the rebound into the bottom left corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:2.
61' Augsburg take a short corner kick.
60' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. Now Augsburg have a corner.
58' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but it's cleared.

57' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' The shot by Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Pavao Pervan.
54' Jeffrey Gouweleeuw (Augsburg) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Timo Gerach who sees an offensive foul.
52' Dangerous play by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg). Timo Gerach blows his whistle for a foul.
50' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
49' Arne Maier (Augsburg) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
48' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Iago (Augsburg). Augsburg will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
48' Felix Uduokhai (Augsburg) is penalised for a foul. Timo Gerach had a clear view and blows his whistle.
48' A dangerous looking corner kick from Arne Maier (Augsburg) is cleared to safety by the defence.

47' Iago (Augsburg) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Augsburg.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+2' 1 - 1 It's in the back of the net! Arne Maier (Augsburg) tries his luck from the edge of the box and his shot takes a deflection and goes past the stranded Pavao Pervan. He makes it 1:1.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) cannot believe that he has been told to leave the field of play after the referee blows his whistle and sends him off!
44' The resulting corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) comes to nothing.
43' Kevin Paredes (Wolfsburg) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. It will be a corner kick for Wolfsburg.
43' 10:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
40' The ball goes out of play. Wolfsburg are awarded a corner kick.
40' Wolfsburg failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
38' A quickly taken corner by Wolfsburg.
37' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
37' One of the players from Augsburg times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
36' A pass from Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) is intercepted by Finn Dahmen and the move breaks down.
34' The players claim that Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
33' A cross from Kevin Mbabu (Augsburg) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
32' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
30' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
29' Fredrik Jensen (Augsburg) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
28' Referee Timo Gerach sees the trip by Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
27' Wolfsburg enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
24' Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) makes some space to meet a perfect cross inside the box, but he blazes his shot over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty.
22' Ruben Vargas (Augsburg) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.

19' Ermedin Demirovic (Augsburg) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Wolfsburg will have a goal kick.
18' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Finn Dahmen intercepts the ball.
18' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Augsburg was in an offside position.
16' Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Finn Dahmen makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
14' Patrick Wimmer beats an opponent and whips a cross into the box towards Ridle Baku (Wolfsburg), who smashes a first-time shot high over the bar.
12' Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
12' A player from Wolfsburg commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
11' Wolfsburg win a corner.
11' That's unlucky! Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
9' 1 - 0 Patrick Wimmer (Wolfsburg) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
9' The resulting corner from Maximilian Arnold (Wolfsburg) is cleared.
8' Tiago Tomas (Wolfsburg) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Wolfsburg will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
3' Mattias Svanberg (Wolfsburg) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.

2' Jonas Wind (Wolfsburg) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant long-range cross, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. Wolfsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
